title: Meeting convex regions
notes: Keep one adult at each table to read and record while children choose groups and placements. The middle return route P5-6 is already marked on guide p4. Other return choices: K-1 can play the fixed-three or free-placement game (P4 or P6), adding the three-label location question (P5) when ready. Grades 4-5 can use saved splits to examine coincident labels and multiple winners (P4-5), then make the all-arrangements and minimum-number arguments (P6-7). Keep the two regions filled and the shared point explicit.
